goal: Multi-factor authentication review: where second factors are required, enrolled and recovered.
use: Multi-factor authentication review: where second factors are required, enrolled and recovered. Use when code enables, enforces or recovers second factors.

steps.note: List the enforcement points. Find where a second factor is required.
Check bypass. Flag paths that sign in without the second factor.
Check enrolment. Flag factors that can be added without re-verification.
Check recovery. Flag recovery codes that are reusable or stored in plain text.
Report. Each path with file and line, severity and the fix.
